$comment: Canonical list of SHIPPED, demonstrable features. Source of truth for marketing copy. The marketing site's build (servogo.co.uk) fetches this file and fails if any pricing-page or homepage claim references a key not listed here. When you ship or remove a feature, update this file in the same change. Keep it in sync with MARKETING_FACTS.md. Served at https://app.servogo.co.uk/marketing-manifest.json.

features.scheduling.recurring_plans: Recurring service plans (weekly/monthly/specific-day) that auto-generate jobs
features.scheduling.one_off_jobs: One-off jobs created and assigned to a tech and date
features.scheduling.drag_reorder: Drag-drop reordering of day-view stops with live time recalculation
features.scheduling.route_optimisation: One-click straight-line route optimisation with optional home start/return
features.scheduling.breaks: Configurable breaks and pauses between stops
features.scheduling.cancel_reschedule: Cancel or reschedule jobs from the day view
features.dayview.map: Interactive map with stops, route lines, and pin highlighting
features.dayview.weather: Weather panel for the route day via OpenWeather (current + hourly)
features.dayview.drive_estimates: Straight-line drive time and distance estimates between stops
features.visits.mark_complete: Mark jobs complete from the day view (web or mobile-web)
features.visits.history: Immutable visit records build a per-client service history
features.visits.job_history_export: Searchable, filterable job history with CSV export
features.invoicing.auto_generate: Auto-generate draft invoices from completed visits (per visit, rolling, or monthly batch)
features.invoicing.manual: Manual invoices with custom line items
features.invoicing.branded_pdf: Branded PDF invoices (logo and primary colour)
features.invoicing.email: Email delivery of invoices to clients
features.invoicing.stripe_links: Stripe payment links on invoices with auto-mark-paid
features.invoicing.manual_payments: Manual payment recording (cash, bank transfer, etc.)
features.invoicing.status_tracking: Status tracking: draft, due, partially paid, paid, overdue, cancelled
features.invoicing.numbering: Invoice numbering with prefix and annual reset
features.invoicing.tax_terms: Tax rate, VAT-inclusive/exclusive pricing, payment terms, late fee policy
features.quotes.workflow: Quote draft, send, accept, decline workflow
features.quotes.line_items: Quote line items with description, quantity, unit price
features.quotes.accept_email: Client accepts a quote via email link
features.quotes.convert_to_jobs: One-click conversion of accepted quotes into scheduled jobs
features.clients.directory: Client directory with search and filters
features.clients.csv_import: Bulk CSV import with auto field mapping
features.clients.squeegee_compat: Squeegee CSV column-name compatibility out of the box
features.messaging.email: Email messages to clients, with threading
features.messaging.bulk_send: Bulk send to multiple selected clients
features.personnel.roles: Four roles (owner, manager, dispatcher, tech) with scoped access
features.personnel.home_address: Per-tech home address override for routing
features.personnel.pay_rules: Per-tech pay rules: commission percent, flat per visit, or hourly
features.payroll.earnings: Tech earnings calculated from completed visits and pay rule
features.payroll.periods: Period selection: month, last month, quarter, YTD, or custom range
features.payroll.live_calc: Figures calculated live with CSV export at point of pay
features.payroll.owner_manager_only: Payroll visible to owners and managers only
features.dashboard.outstanding: Outstanding invoices, overdue jobs, upcoming work
features.dashboard.cashflow_chart: Weekly and monthly cashflow chart (collected vs billed)
features.dashboard.date_range: Date range selector with delta vs prior period
features.settings.branding: Logo and primary colour for client-facing PDFs and emails
features.settings.invoice_config: Invoice numbering, generation mode, tax, terms, late fees
features.techview.todays_route: Tech today's route with next stop highlighted (mobile-web)
features.techview.stop_details: Address, notes, service details per stop
features.techview.maps_handoff: One-tap handoff to the device maps app for navigation
features.techview.mark_complete: Tech mark complete with optional completion note
features.techview.scoped_access: Techs see only their own assignments
features.integrations.stripe: Stripe payment links and platform subscription billing
features.integrations.email: Email via SES, SendGrid, or SMTP
features.export.csv: CSV export for clients, service plans, job history, invoices, payroll
features.export.pdf: Branded PDF for invoices and quotes
